scenarios.name: Absent or unqualified provider
scenarios.required_evidence: No positive projection or create; fake replies/local JSON cannot authenticate

scenarios.name: Original channel and session establishment
scenarios.required_evidence: Wrong endpoint/process generation, epoch/authority/clock joins or unavailable original witness refuse before claim

scenarios.name: Root and peer delegation
scenarios.required_evidence: Authenticated Root and exact delegated peer/operation/role; self-authored/forged identity refuses

scenarios.name: Actual loaded source/runtime closure
scenarios.required_evidence: Byte substitution, namespace/import/bootstrap/runtime drift refuses; source hashes alone do not attest loaded code

scenarios.name: Durable first consumption
scenarios.required_evidence: One unused UUID commits atomically to exact authority; original durable witness required

scenarios.name: Duplicate or competing claims
scenarios.required_evidence: Across sessions/authority changes/competing requests, at most one first consumption; sequential/model checks alone do not prove atomic race behavior

scenarios.name: Ambiguous claim and restart
scenarios.required_evidence: Dropped/partial response or restart yields consumed UNKNOWN; no mutating retry, no absence-based rearm

scenarios.name: Cleanup-only consumption and cancellation
scenarios.required_evidence: Late stop/deadline bounds bookkeeping without output/runtime work; cancellation and original channel closure proved or UNKNOWN

scenarios.name: Claim/accounting bootstrap
scenarios.required_evidence: No hidden claim DB/lock/export; independent prior authority and accounting proof before allocation; unavailable proof refuses

scenarios.name: Original peer message bytes
scenarios.required_evidence: Unknown/altered/mismatched/missing message, duplicate key, invalid UTF8 or unsupported provider schema refuses

scenarios.name: Independent review identity and role
scenarios.required_evidence: Authors cannot certify themselves; source/actual reviewers differ; delegation exact to operation/role

scenarios.name: Postpublication confirmation
scenarios.required_evidence: Fresh original peer message binds exact saved review path/bytes/hash/text; missing/negative/overflow/changed identity refuses adoption

scenarios.name: Complete governed artifact domain
scenarios.required_evidence: Unknown ordinary writer, off-directory copy or unregistered producer prevents complete census; exact immutable parent/metadata join and all partition conservation, no silently filtered nonmetadata files; optional COMPONENT_NATIVE fixture transaction has distinct UUID/exact scenario/16 role-path-cap matches, complete fixture charges, disjoint parent/main/fixture views and no production promotion

scenarios.name: Lost/late events and producer seal
scenarios.required_evidence: Gap/overflow/epoch reset/late unjoined event or missing domain closure refuses; snapshot alone cannot seal

scenarios.name: Partial and ambiguous artifacts
scenarios.required_evidence: Empty/partial creates count; duplicate/alias/reparse/hardlink/path/native-identity uncertainty refuses; no moved/released charge

scenarios.name: Final census ordering
scenarios.required_evidence: Artifacts during final verification or backend close detected before CLOSED; original channel valid through final barrier/closure

scenarios.name: Bounded transport and frame replay
scenarios.required_evidence: Size/depth/node/sequence/digest/joins/torn/extra-tail/wrong-channel failures refuse; parser emits only unauthenticated data;8-byte uint32 little-endian H/P prefix, H<=4088, exact request<=8192/response<=135168 full bytes, prefix/header agreement, checksum, maximum-boundary/truncated-prefix/body/extra-tail and unchecked-length refusal

scenarios.name: Original deadline/cancellation
scenarios.required_evidence: Delayed/blocking provider and equality/rollback refuse within fixed work/cleanup/hard limits; no worker/thread timeout masquerading as closure

scenarios.name: Exact discovery partition
scenarios.required_evidence: All580 existing identities plus exact future additions mapped once; missing/extra/duplicate/skip/alias/load_tests/partial collection refuses

scenarios.name: Hash/RAM/native verification preservation
scenarios.required_evidence: Every original live sensor/read/hash/recensus/final verification remains; models do not discharge H10 or real concurrency/native behavior

scenarios.name: Resource/process/stop ownership
scenarios.required_evidence: Existing resource/thread/device/startup/freshness/watchdog/Job/pipe/native-handle guards and cleanup evidence remain on every success/failure path

scenarios.name: Complete capture and failure envelope
scenarios.required_evidence: Exact whole tool transport including escaping/errors/cancellations fits fixed slots by proof; unexpected overflow refuses without sidecar

scenarios.name: Lifecycle and complete unit budget
scenarios.required_evidence: No human/model wait or required work moved across reset clocks; no partial native subcase or split-Q acceptance; unknown whole budget unadmitted

scenarios.name: Scope and preserved obligations
scenarios.required_evidence: Component-only result cannot admit Q/P/science or erase prior failures/custody/debt; old ledgers and frozen sources unchanged
